carpet.rule.commandFly.name: Enable fly command
carpet.rule.commandFly.desc: Allows players to execute the /fly command to fly.
carpet.rule.flyDisableSprinting.name: Disable sprinting when flying with /fly
carpet.rule.flyDisableSprinting.desc: Disables sprinting for players while they are flying using /fly.
carpet.rule.commandScale.name: Enable scale command
carpet.rule.commandScale.desc: Allows players to execute the /scale command to scale their own size.
carpet.rule.playerScaleMinValue.name: Player scale minimum value
carpet.rule.playerScaleMinValue.desc: Sets the minimum value for player scaling.
carpet.rule.playerScaleMaxValue.name: Player scale maximum value
carpet.rule.playerScaleMaxValue.desc: Sets the maximum value for player scaling.
carpet.rule.commandHome.name: Enable home command
carpet.rule.commandHome.desc: Allows players to execute the /home command to teleport to their spawn point.
carpet.rule.commandHomeWorld.name: Enable home command world option
carpet.rule.commandHomeWorld.desc: Allows players to execute /home world to teleport to the world spawn point.
carpet.rule.commandHomeCountdown.name: Home command teleport countdown
carpet.rule.commandHomeCountdown.desc: After executing the home command, teleportation occurs after a countdown.
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.d: Allows players to execute the /observerFreezeAreas command to freeze observers within an area
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.e: [Note] The highlight sub-option is available after installing the Feca mod on the client
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenSmallFlowers.de: Allows bone meal to be used to ripen small flowers.
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenChorusFlower.de: Allows bone meal to be used to ripen chorus flowers.
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenSmallFlowers.ex: This feature may be overridden by carpet-AMS's fertilizableSmallFlower. If it does not take effect, please enable both options at the same time.
carpet.rule.chorusFruitAsSeed.name: Chorus fruit as seed
carpet.rule.chorusFruitAsSeed.desc: Allows chorus fruit to be used as a seed, planted by right-clicking on the top surface of end stone.
carpet.rule.mineableBuddingAmethyst.name: Mineable budding amethyst
carpet.rule.mineableBuddingAmethyst.desc: Allows players to mine budding amethyst blocks.
carpet.rule.activeMending.name: Active Mending
carpet.rule.activeMending.desc: Items with Mending equipped by the player (main hand/offhand/armor slots) will actively consume XP to repair themselves.
carpet.rule.craftableReinforcedDeepSlate: Allows players to craft reinforced deepslate.
carpet.rule.craftableEndPortalFrame.name: Craftable end portal frame
carpet.rule.craftableEndPortalFrame.desc: Allows players to craft end portal frames.
